parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The new remarks for the address. To delete the remarks, leave this parameter empty.
